en:
That Kokichi... 
He better not have been serious...

He must just be frustrated by everything 
that's happened...I think.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kaito for a while?

Well, it's fine now. My punch probably 
brought him to his senses.

If not...I'll speak to him through my fists 
as many times as it takes!
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I grew a little closer today.
